GUI.note: Generative User Interface: a static declaration the GUI can boot from; a connected .me resolves it.

bars.note: The edge bars around the content. All five are declared; which are on is resolved at runtime.

sticky.note: Sticky options strip under the top bar.
sticky.label: Sticky options

bars.label: Bars

content.note: Where the current page renders. Each child is a page: `component` implements it, `route` serves it.

landing.note: The .me QR and sign-in / register / recover. Behavior stays in the component.
landing.label: Landing

users.note: Public claims directory: who has claimed this namespace.
users.label: Users

blockchain.note: Everything written to this namespace, as one stream.
blockchain.label: Blockchain

content.label: Content
